name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin near $80,500, 7% off its high; no stablecoin de-peg
state: Bitcoin was near $80,500 early on 5 Nov, 7% below its 52-week high and up 3.9% on the week, far from the 25% Watch line (Yahoo Finance). Binance withdrawals resumed from 1 Nov after the theft the FBI attributes to North Korea, and no stablecoin de-peg or exchange failure had been reported as of 5 Nov.
for_you: Crypto prices are steady by their own standards. Holders on exchanges remain exposed to hacks and withdrawal freezes, which are not covered by deposit protection.
rubric_hit: BTC drawdown 12.5% below the 25% Watch line
why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
